snippet.title: A Game About Penguins - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST A GAME ABOUT PENGUINS ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3617840/A_Game_About_Penguins/

This is your cozy invitation to waddle into a snowy social world full of laughter, mini-games, and unforgettable memories with friends. Customize your penguin, explore snowy hills, go fishing, join snowball fights, build snowmen, and so much more!
